reviews.title: NOTHING LIKE THE 1ST FUN RUN
reviews.text: Huge learning curve for veterans from the first Fun Run. And don’t even get me started on the ads😒they place the ads button so “CONVENIENTLY” close to the arrow to go back to the lobby. If I wanted to watch ads, I’d hop on YouTube🙄you can’t even get different animals unless you’re paying to play. Oh, and the 2v2 matchmaking is BOGUS! If you’re just starting out, don’t even bother with that game mode. You’ll be playing against seasoned Fun Run 4 players who have abilities that you don’t even have yet or have yet to unlock. Hate how hard it is to play a game when the opponents have such a HUGE advantage over you. And no, it’s not a skill issue, this game is really PAY TO PLAY!!

reviews.title: Gameplay undermined by Aggressive Monetization
reviews.text:
Fun Run used to be a lot more fun and rewarding. Now it feels like the game actively penalizes you for leveling up.

Leveling itself is easy, but the rewards are ridiculously low, especially when you’re already paying for the Battle Pass. You barely earn enough coins to make meaningful progress, yet the game constantly pushes you to buy more just to level up individual animals.

The microtransactions are excessive. $50 for one skin is hard to justify, especially when there isn’t much else worth spending your coins on. The game feels like it’s trying to copy the monetization model of much bigger games while offering far less value. Oh and of course the normal tons of ads but you can pay to remove it. 

It’s a mobile racing game. It shouldn’t feel like a constant attempt to drain your wallet just to enjoy progression. You guys are not Epic Games… but take a page out of their book and price accordingly.

ALSO fix the buttons. When I hit up it goes down. I’m on a brand new phone so this is the game.

reviews.title: FIX YOUR GAME!!!
reviews.text: I have been playing this game since April 24, 2024 with my best friend. We have had a lot of fun memories playing but quit during 2025 since there was no new updates. Recently, we just got back on. This game is the buggiest game I’ve ever played and it is not my wifi because i have played other games with ZERO lag. Every time me or my best friend would use a power up such as ice axe or the impact grenade, it would not register making us lose the entire game. Why is this? However, when the other team uses their power up, it works. Why? Once again, it is not our wifi. Please fix this game because I truly enjoy playing this game but the bugs make it boring and unfair. Thank you.

reviews.title: Porcupine 😡
reviews.text: I absolutely love this game, and my entire family plays it. However, the porcupine mechanic is ridiculous and needs to be changed. When you kill the porcupine, it throws its quills into the air and can still kill you. There should not be a punishment for successfully defeating an enemy. Killing the porcupine should be a reward, not a consequence. The porcupine should take the consequence, not the player after it’s already dead.
